item.title: Vestibulær paroksysmi
item.description:
Hyppige, korte og stereotype svimmelhedsanfald. Kriterier fra Bárány Society, differentialdiagnoser, udredning, behandling med natriumkanalblokkere, evidensen og en lang quiz til sidst.

Kilder:

  • Vestibular paroxysmia: Diagnostic criteria, Classification Committee of the Bárány Society, Journal of Vestibular Research, 2016, https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC9249278
  • Vestibular paroxysmia: a systematic review, Dieterich og Brandt, Journal of Neurology, 2025, https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC11814022
  • Vestibular Paroxysmia with Neurovascular Cross Compression and Antiepileptic Drugs: A Systematic Review, Reynard m.fl., Audiology Research, 2025, https://www.mdpi.com/2039-4349/15/2/28
  • Sodium Channel Blockers for Vestibular Paroxysmia in Children, Audiology Research, 2025, https://www.mdpi.com/2039-4349/15/3/65
  • A randomized double-blind, placebo-controlled, cross-over trial (Vestparoxy) of the treatment of vestibular paroxysmia with oxcarbazepine, Bayer m.fl., Journal of Neurology, 2018, https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC5808055
  • Vestibular paroxysmia: Long-term clinical outcome after treatment, Chen m.fl., Frontiers in Neurology, 2022, https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC9614226
  • Vestibular paroxysmia: diagnostic features and medical treatment, Hüfner m.fl., 2008, https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/18809837/
  • Vestibular paroxysmia: a treatable neurovascular cross-compression syndrome, Brandt, Strupp og Dieterich, Journal of Neurology, 2016, https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC4833786
  • Treatment of vestibular paroxysmia with lacosamide, Neurology: Clinical Practice, https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC6927438
  • Vestibular paroxysmia: Clinical features and imaging findings; a literature review, 2021, https://www.em-consulte.com/article/1463856/vestibular-paroxysmia-clinical-features-and-imagin
  • Radiological and intraoperative findings of a rare case of vestibular paroxysmia, Neurological Sciences, 2024, https://link.springer.com/10.1007/s10072-024-07695-2
  • Dansk Selskab for Otorhinolaryngologi, Hoved- og Halskirurgi, Vestibulogi, kliniske retningslinjer, ingen retningslinje for vestibulær paroksysmi, https://dsohh.dk/publikationer/kliniske-retningslinjer/vestibulogi/

Stemmer: Røst. Indholdet er genereret med kunstig intelligens og kan indeholde fejl.

item.title: Vestibulær migræne
item.description:
Diagnostiske kriterier, differentialdiagnoser, udredning og behandling af vestibulær migræne, med tyndt evidensgrundlag og en lang quiz til sidst.

Kilder:

  • Vestibulær migræne (migræne-associeret svimmelhed), Lægehåndbogen, sundhed.dk, revideret 2023, https://cms.sundhed.dk/Laegehaandbogen/oere-naese-hals/tilstande-og-sygdomme/nervesygdomme/vestibulaer-migraene
  • Vestibular migraine: Diagnostic criteria, Bárány Society og International Headache Society, 2012 og opdatering, https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/9249276
  • Pharmacological interventions for prophylaxis of vestibular migraine, Cochrane Database of Systematic Reviews, 2023, https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC10093999
  • Pharmacological interventions for acute attacks of vestibular migraine, Cochrane Database of Systematic Reviews, 2023, https://research-information.bris.ac.uk/en/publications/pharmacological-interventions-for-acute-attacks-of-vestibular-mig/
  • Results and lessons learnt from a randomized controlled trial: prophylactic treatment of vestibular migraine with metoprolol, Trials, 2019, https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/pmc/articles/PMC6937687/
  • Prophylactic treatments for vestibular migraine: a systematic review and network meta-analysis of randomized clinical trials, Frontiers in Pharmacology, 2023, https://www.frontiersin.org/articles/10.3389/fphar.2023.1332973/full
  • A placebo controlled, randomized clinical trial of galcanezumab for vestibular migraine: the INVESTMENT study, Headache, 2024, https://www.neurologylive.com/view/galcanezumab-demonstrates-promise-therapy-for-vestibular-migraine
  • Comparative effectiveness and safety of preventive treatments for vestibular migraine: a systematic review and network meta-analysis, 2025, https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/pmc/articles/PMC12754936/
  • Triptans in the acute treatment of vestibular migraine attacks, konferenceabstrakt, American Academy of Neurology, 2026, https://index.mirasmart.com/AAN2026/PDFfiles/AAN2026-004849.html

Stemmer: Røst. Indholdet er genereret med kunstig intelligens og kan indeholde fejl.

item.title: Persisterende postural-perceptuel svimmelhed
item.description:
Kronisk funktionel svimmelhed. Hvordan stillingen stilles, hvad der skal udelukkes, hvad evidensen siger om behandling, og hvilke faldgruber man skal kende.

Kilder:

  • Staab et al., Diagnostic criteria for persistent postural-perceptual dizziness, Journal of Vestibular Research, 2017, https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/29036855/
  • Webster et al., Non-pharmacological interventions for persistent postural-perceptual dizziness, Cochrane Database of Systematic Reviews, 2023, https://rehabilitation.cochrane.org/non-pharmacological-interventions-persistent-postural-perceptual-dizziness
  • Zheng et al., Effect of conservative therapy for persistent postural-perceptual dizziness, Frontiers in Psychiatry, 2025, https://www.frontiersin.org/journals/psychiatry/articles/10.3389/fpsyt.2025.1676218/full
  • Persistent Postural-Perceptual Dizziness: A Practical Approach to Diagnosis and Patient Communication, European Journal of Neurology, 2026, https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/pmc/articles/PMC12884132/
  • Persistent Postural-Perceptual Dizziness, StatPearls, 2026, https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/books/NBK578198/

Stemmer: Røst. Indholdet er genereret med kunstig intelligens og kan indeholde fejl.
